purpose: Frozen, information-preserving contingency policy applied ONLY if a fully-materialized Item 6 Stage-1 Converse request would exceed MAX_REQUEST_UTF8_BYTES (32768). It defines a deterministic, value-neutral order in which evidence scopes are dropped, never using any future outcome and never systematically privileging one metric family.
applied_in_current_freeze_reason: All 120 fully-materialized requests are <= 32768 bytes (observed max ~28.2 KB) under the frozen COMPACT_MAP encoding and compact scope grid; no compression was applied. This artifact is retained as a bound-preserving contingency only.
determinism: Given a packet exceeding the ceiling, the policy deterministically removes evidence items in the frozen tier order below until the full request fits, recomputing the packet hash after removal. No value, sample_n, or reliability is altered; only whole scopes are dropped, lowest-information-density tiers first.

removal_tiers_in_order.drop: RECENT_5 window items for the AGAINST perspective (recent concession form)
removal_tiers_in_order.rationale: recent-form on the concession side is the most redundant with ALL_PRIOR concession + recent FOR form

removal_tiers_in_order.drop: HOME/AWAY venue split items for FULL_MATCH FOR (keep ALL venue)
removal_tiers_in_order.rationale: venue splits are secondary to the ALL-venue level; drop both HOME and AWAY together to avoid privileging a venue
retain one half-state view (second half) plus full match; drop first-half symmetrically across ALL metrics that have it

removal_tiers_in_order.drop: RECENT_5 window items for the FOR perspective (keep ALL_PRIOR)
removal_tiers_in_order.rationale: form context is secondary to long-run level; dropped last among windowed items, symmetric across metrics

invariants_preserved_at_every_tier: both TEAM_A and TEAM_B remain represented
both FOR (attack) and AGAINST (defense) full-match ALL-venue ALL_PRIOR items remain for every metric present
every metric family present remains represented (no metric family is fully removed before another)
sample_n and reliability remain attached to every surviving item
no future outcome, market, candidate id, or salience is ever consulted or added
never_does: use future outcomes or OOS results to decide survivors
systematically privilege corners, shots, or any single metric
hash_after_compression: packet_sha256 is recomputed over the compressed packet body; the materialized request set binds the post-compression packet hash.
